data.summary:
Business Analyst with 5+ years of experience across Capital Markets, specializing in Corporate Actions, Fixed Income, Trade Lifecycle, Settlements, SWIFT payments and product/system migration. Experienced in requirements gathering, BRD/FRD, functional decomposition, user stories, acceptance criteria, Agile/Scrum delivery, UAT and stakeholder management. Proven ability to work with Business, Technology, QA and Product teams to translate business needs into functional solutions and support end-to-end implementation across Capital Markets platforms.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Feb 2026 – Present
Citi Bank (Optimum Infosolutions Payroll) Business Analyst – Capital Markets | UAT & Migration Pune, Maharashtra • Lead business analysis activities for the migration from NCS to TCS BaNCS, supporting Capital Markets processes across Corporate
Actions, settlement, payments and SWIFT release workflows.
Gather and refine functional requirements, BRDs/FRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria for Corporate Action settlement,
announcement payments and SWIFT release processes.
Collaborate with Business, Technology and QA stakeholders to clarify requirements, identify functional gaps and support resolution of
implementation issues.
Participate in Agile delivery through sprint updates, stakeholder governance and progress reporting; maintain visibility of risks, issues
and release readiness.
Support UAT and business validation by reviewing scenarios, validating delivered functionality and supporting sign-off for Capital
Markets migration releases.
Feb 2023 – Feb 2026
Deutsche Bank Business Analyst – Capital Markets Pune, Maharashtra • Worked on Capital Markets change and migration initiatives across Equities, Fixed Income and Corporate Actions, supporting end-to-
end trade, settlement and payment processes.
Gathered and analysed functional requirements and translated them into BRDs, FRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria for system
enhancements and migration initiatives.
Worked on Corporate Action settlement and payment processes, including mandatory and voluntary events, announcement flows
and downstream settlement impacts.
Supported SWIFT-based settlement and payment workflows by analysing message flows, release issues and downstream processing
requirements.
Participated in Agile/Scrum delivery, supporting backlog refinement, user-story grooming, sprint updates and stakeholder reviews
with the Product Owner.
Performed gap analysis and process mapping across trade lifecycle, settlement and payment workflows to identify process
improvements and system enhancement opportunities.
Chaitanya Jadhav | Business Analyst – Capital Markets
• Collaborated with Business, Technology, QA and Project teams to define functional behaviour, resolve issues and support
implementation; led UAT and business sign-off for a Payment Automation project.
Supported regression and sanity validation following deployments and defect fixes as part of the broader SDLC. BNY Mellon Intermediate Representative – Corporate Actions Pune, Maharashtra • Processed mandatory and voluntary Corporate Action events and performed post-payment reconciliation across Capital Markets workflows.
Conducted quarterly UAT with business sign-off for system releases and supported automation initiatives for Corporate Actions
processing.
Resolved system issues raised through JIRA and partnered with stakeholders on requirement gathering and solution documentation.
Conducted training and knowledge-transfer sessions for new joiners to improve onboarding and process understanding.
SELECTED CAPITAL MARKETS PROJECTS
Payment Automation – Deutsche Bank
Gathered business requirements and supported UAT through production validation across Corporate Action payment processing and
SWIFT flows.
Corporate Action System Migration – Deutsche Bank
Supported requirement refinement and migration of mandatory/voluntary Corporate Action payment processing, including exceptions
and SWIFT validation.
TCS BaNCS / NCS Migration – Citi
Supporting product transformation across Corporate Actions settlement, announcement payments and SWIFT release processes.
IMPACT & TOOLS
Built a Power BI Business Volume Monitoring Dashboard to help leadership track performance metrics and support organizational
restructuring decisions.
Developed Excel Macros for Corporate Action entitlement calculations, improving productivity and accuracy by 25%.
Tools: JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Power BI, Advanced Excel, Macros, CATS, TCS BaNCS
Methods: Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, SDLC, UAT, Migration, Release Readiness
